remarks: Charming 3-Bedroom Home with endless potential in prime location. Nestled in one of the most desirable neighborhoods, this classic 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers a rare opportunity to create your dream space. While the interior awaits your personal touch, the home features a finished lower level and sits on a beautiful, level lot perfect for outdoor enjoyment or future expansion. Enjoy the convenience of being close to train, schools, parks, tennis courts, town, restaurants, and shopping. With plenty of potential to renovate or add square footage, this property is ideal for buyers looking to customize and invest in a sought-after location. Whether you're a first-time buyer, investor, or someone ready to make a home truly your own, this gem is full of possibilities.
